entities.name: Manuel Cappai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel Cappai is an Italian boxer who competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the light flyweight division where he lost in the first round to Filipino boxer Mark Anthony Barriga. Cappai won a bronze medal in the flyweight division at the 2018 Mediterranean Games.
